facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on July 4, 2024 that CTO Yang Han was recognized as a finalist in the 2024 Toronto ORBIE Awards by InspireTORONTO.
facts.quote: today announce that CTO Yang Han has been recognized as a finalist in the 2024 Toronto ORBIE® Awards by InspireTORONTO

facts.fact: Since its inception, over 500 leaders have been honored with the ORBIE Award, according to the press release.
facts.quote: Since its inception, over 500 leaders have been honored with the ORBIE® Award.

facts.fact: ORBIE finalists are selected through an independent peer review process led by prior ORBIE recipients, based on criteria such as leadership effectiveness, technology innovation, and community engagement.
facts.quote: Finalists are selected through an independent peer review process, led by prior ORBIE recipients, based on criteria such as leadership effectiveness

facts.fact: InspireTORONTO has over 40 chapters in its Inspire Leadership Network, per the InspireTORONTO description in the press release.
facts.quote: With over 40 chapters, the Inspire Leadership Network is a national membership organization

facts.fact: StackAdapt is used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world, according to its own description.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, a rating attributed to G2 rather than an independent figure in the release.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2
